        "contents": "4. **School Email Verification** - Unverified users must:\n   - Enter their school email (@pef.czu.cz)\n   - System checks if email is in pre-registered list\n   - If valid, sends 6-digit verification code\n   - User enters code to complete verification\n5. **Access Granted** - Verified users access the dashboard\n\n## Database Schema\n\n### Tables\n\n#### &#96;profiles&#96;\nExtended user info linked to Supabase auth.users\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK, FK → auth.users.id) | No | Links to Supabase auth |\n| full_name | TEXT | No | User's display name |\n| role | ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin') | No | User role |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | Yes | Assigned team (students/team leaders only) |\n| is_verified | BOOLEAN | No | School email verified? Default: false |\n| school_email | TEXT | Yes | Verified school email |\n| locale | TEXT | No | Preferred language ('cs', 'en'). Default: 'cs' |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Registration time |\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Last update time |\n\n#### &#96;teams&#96;\nTeam companies (tymove firmy)\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Team identifier |\n| name | TEXT | No | Team name |\n| year | INTEGER | No | Cohort year (1, 2, 3) |\n| is_active | BOOLEAN | No | Still active team? Default: true |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n#### &#96;pre_registered_emails&#96;\nAdmin-imported student list from Excel\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Record identifier |\n| email | TEXT (unique) | No | School email from Excel |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | No | Assigned team |\n| role | ENUM | No | Expected role |\n| full_name | TEXT | Yes | Name from Excel (optional) |\n| claimed_by | UUID (FK → profiles.id) | Yes | User who claimed this email |\n| claimed_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Yes | When claimed |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Import time |\n\n#### &#96;verification_codes&#96;",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE reservations (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    room_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    user_id UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,  -- NULL for system reservations (HC)\n    team_id UUID REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,      -- For TS reservations\n    recurring_schedule_id UUID REFERENCES recurring_schedules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,  -- Link to recurring schedule\n    reservation_type reservation_type NOT NULL DEFAULT 'personal',\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    reason TEXT,                         -- Required for personal reservations\n    person_count INTEGER,                -- Required for personal reservations\n    start_time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\n    end_time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\n    is_cowork_open BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,  -- Allow others to join?\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'cancelled')),\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    \n    -- Ensure valid time range\n    CONSTRAINT valid_reservation_time CHECK (end_time &gt; start_time),\n    \n    -- Prevent overlapping active reservations for the same room\n    CONSTRAINT no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (\n        room_id WITH =,\n        tstzrange(start_time, end_time) WITH &amp;&amp;\n    ) WHERE (status = 'active')\n);\n\n-- Cowork participants table\n-- Stores users who joined open cowork reservations\nCREATE TABLE cowork_participants (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    reservation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES reservations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    joined_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    \n    -- Each user can only join a reservation once\n    UNIQUE(reservation_id, user_id)\n);\n\n-- Room issues table\n-- Stores reported problems with rooms\nCREATE TABLE room_issues (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),",

        "contents": "CREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage pre-registered emails\" ON pre_registered_emails\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Verification codes: Users can only see their own codes\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can view own verification codes\" ON verification_codes\n    FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);\n\n-- Verification codes: Users can create codes for themselves\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can create own verification codes\" ON verification_codes\n    FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);\n\n-- Verification codes: Users can update their own codes (for attempts/used)\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can update own verification codes\" ON verification_codes\n    FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id)\n    WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);\n\n-- Verification codes: Admins can manage all codes\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage verification codes\" ON verification_codes\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Insert some sample teams for development\nINSERT INTO teams (name, year, is_active) VALUES\n    ('Tuuli', 1, true),\n    ('Tuuli', 1, true),\n    ('Impact', 2, true),\n    ('Growth', 2, true),\n    ('Legacy', 3, true);",

        "contents": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  email text not null,\n  name text,\n  picture text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Indexes for auth queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Relationships\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐\n│   auth.users    │       │    profiles     │\n│  (Supabase)     │       │  (Auth only)    │\n├─────────────────┤       ├─────────────────┤\n│ id (uuid)       │◄──┐   │ id (uuid)       │\n│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │",

        "contents": "CREATE INDEX idx_profiles_is_verified ON profiles(is_verified);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_email ON pre_registered_emails(email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_claimed_by ON pre_registered_emails(claimed_by);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_user_id ON verification_codes(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_school_email ON verification_codes(school_email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_expires_at ON verification_codes(expires_at);\n\n-- Function to handle new user signup\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, team_id, is_verified, locale, created_at, updated_at)\n    VALUES (\n        NEW.id,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', ''),\n        COALESCE((NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'role')::user_role, 'student'),\n        CASE \n            WHEN NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id' IS NOT NULL \n            THEN (NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id')::UUID \n            ELSE NULL \n        END,\n        FALSE,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'locale', 'cs'),\n        NOW(),\n        NOW()\n    );\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- Trigger to create profile on user signup\nCREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created\n    AFTER INSERT ON auth.users\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();\n\n-- Function to update updated_at timestamp\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    NEW.updated_at = NOW();\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\n\n-- Trigger to auto-update updated_at on profiles\nCREATE TRIGGER update_profiles_updated_at\n    BEFORE UPDATE ON profiles\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();\n\n-- Row Level Security (RLS) Policies\n\n-- Enable RLS on all tables\nALTER TABLE teams ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE pre_registered_emails ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\nALTER TABLE verification_codes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;",

        "contents": "/**\n * Coach dashboard for managing Training Sessions and schedule breaks\n * Only accessible by coaches and admins\n */\nexport default async function ReservationSettingsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is coach or admin\n  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile(supabase)\n\n  if (profile?.role !== \"coach\" &amp;&amp; profile?.role !== \"admin\") {\n    redirect(\"/dashboard/reservations\");\n  }\n\n  const isAdmin = profile?.role === \"admin\";\n\n  // Fetch all data\n  const [roomsResult, schedulesResult, breaksResult, teamsResult, issuesResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // Rooms that can have TS\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"can_have_ts\", true)\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Recurring schedules with team info\n    supabase\n      .from(\"recurring_schedules\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .gte(\"valid_until\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"day_of_week\"),\n\n    // Schedule breaks\n    supabase\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .gte(\"end_date\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"start_date\"),\n\n    // Teams for TS assignment\n    supabase\n      .from(\"teams\")\n      .select(\"id, name, year\")\n      .eq(\"is_active\", true)\n      .order(\"year\")\n      .order(\"name\"),\n\n    // Room issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        reporter:profiles!reported_by(id, full_name),\n        resolver:profiles!resolved_by(id, full_name)\n      &#96;)\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n      .limit(50),\n  ]);\n\n  const rooms = (roomsResult.data || []) as Room[];\n  const schedules = (schedulesResult.data || []) as (RecurringSchedule &amp;         "contents": "| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Import time |\n\n#### &#96;verification_codes&#96;\nTemporary codes for school email verification\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Code identifier |\n| user_id | UUID (FK → profiles.id) | No | Who requested |\n| school_email | TEXT | No | Email to verify |\n| code | TEXT | No | 6-digit code |\n| expires_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Code expiration (10-15 min) |\n| attempts | INTEGER | No | Failed attempts count. Default: 0 |\n| used | BOOLEAN | No | Already used? Default: false |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n### Database Trigger\n\nOn new user signup (auth.users insert), automatically create a profile record:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, is_verified, created_at, updated_at)\n  VALUES (\n    NEW.id,\n    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', ''),\n    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'role', 'student'),\n    FALSE,\n    NOW(),\n    NOW()\n  );\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\nCREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created\n  AFTER INSERT ON auth.users\n  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## UI Screens\n\n### 1. Landing Page (&#96;/&#96;)\n\nMinimal design with Tappka branding:\n- Tappka logo/name\n- Subtitle: \"Studentsky portal Tiimiakatemia\"\n- Login form (email, password)\n- \"Prihlasit se\" button (TAP Red)\n- \"Nemas ucet? Zaregistrovat se\" link\n- Language toggle (CZ/EN)\n\n### 2. Registration Page (&#96;/auth/sign-up&#96;)\n\nForm fields:\n- Full name (required)\n- Email (required) - personal email for login\n- Password (required)\n- Role dropdown (required): Student, Team Leader, Coach, Admin\n- Team dropdown (required if Student/Team Leader): List of active teams\n- \"Zaregistrovat se\" button\n- \"Uz mas ucet? Prihlasit se\" link\n\n### 3. Verification Page (&#96;/verify&#96;)\n\n**Step 1: Enter school email**\n- Heading: \"Overeni skolniho emailu\"\n- Explanation text\n- School email input",

        "contents": "import { getCurrentUserProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Badge } from \"@/components/ui/badge\";\nimport { User, Users, Shield } from \"lucide-react\";\n\nconst ROLE_LABELS: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n  student: \"Student\",\n  team_leader: \"Team Leader\",\n  coach: \"Kouč\",\n  admin: \"Admin\",\n};\n\nexport default async function DashboardPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const {\n    data: { user },\n  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // Get profile with team info\n  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile(supabase)\n\n\n\n  return (\n    &lt;&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"mb-8\"&gt;\n        &lt;h2 className=\"text-3xl font-heading font-bold\"&gt;\n          Vítej, {profile?.name?.split(\" \")[0]}!\n        &lt;/h2&gt;\n        &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground mt-1\"&gt;\n          Toto je tvůj dashboard v Tappka.\n        &lt;/p&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n      {/* Stats cards */}\n      &lt;div className=\"grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3\"&gt;\n        {/* Profile card */}\n        &lt;Card&gt;\n          &lt;CardHeader className=\"flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2\"&gt;\n            &lt;CardTitle className=\"text-sm font-medium\"&gt;Profil&lt;/CardTitle&gt;\n            &lt;User className=\"h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground\" /&gt;\n          &lt;/CardHeader&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "-- Stores reported problems with rooms\nCREATE TABLE room_issues (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    room_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    reported_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,  -- Can be NULL if reporter deleted\n    issue_type issue_type NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    status issue_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,\n    resolved_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- Schedule breaks table\n-- Stores exceptions to TS schedule (Days of Joy, holidays, etc.)\nCREATE TABLE schedule_breaks (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    break_type schedule_break_type NOT NULL,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- 'Days of Joy - Podzim 2026', 'Vánoční prázdniny', etc.\n    start_date DATE NOT NULL,\n    end_date DATE NOT NULL,\n    created_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,  -- Can be NULL if creator deleted\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    \n    -- Ensure valid date range\n    CONSTRAINT valid_break_date_range CHECK (end_date &gt;= start_date)\n);\n\n-- ============================================\n-- INDEXES\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Rooms\nCREATE INDEX idx_rooms_code ON rooms(code);\n\n-- Recurring schedules\nCREATE INDEX idx_recurring_schedules_room ON recurring_schedules(room_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_recurring_schedules_team ON recurring_schedules(team_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_recurring_schedules_day ON recurring_schedules(day_of_week);\nCREATE INDEX idx_recurring_schedules_valid ON recurring_schedules(valid_from, valid_until);\n\n-- Reservations\nCREATE INDEX idx_reservations_room_time ON reservations(room_id, start_time, end_time) WHERE status = 'active';\nCREATE INDEX idx_reservations_user ON reservations(user_id) WHERE status = 'active';\nCREATE INDEX idx_reservations_team ON reservations(team_id) WHERE status = 'active';\nCREATE INDEX idx_reservations_type ON reservations(reservation_type) WHERE status = 'active';\nCREATE INDEX idx_reservations_start ON reservations(start_time) WHERE status = 'active';",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "-- Stores reported problems with rooms",

          },

        "contents": "begin\n  v_encrypted_password := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;&gt;'encrypted_password';\n  \n  if v_encrypted_password is not null then\n    raise exception 'Password-based signups are not allowed. Please use Google OAuth to sign in.';\n  end if;\n  \n  v_provider := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'raw_user_meta_data'-&gt;&gt;'provider';\n  v_app_metadata := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'app_metadata';\n  if v_provider is null and v_app_metadata is not null then\n    v_provider := v_app_metadata-&gt;&gt;'provider';\n  end if;\n  \n  if event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities' is not null then\n    for v_identity in \n      select value from jsonb_array_elements(event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities')\n    loop\n      if v_identity-&gt;&gt;'provider' = 'google' then\n        v_has_google_identity := true;\n        exit;\n      end if;\n    end loop;\n  end if;\n  \n  if v_provider = 'google' or v_has_google_identity then\n    return event;\n  end if;\n  \n  raise exception 'Only Google OAuth signups are allowed. Please use Google to sign in.';\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.before_user_created_hook(jsonb) is 'Hook function that restricts signups to Google OAuth only. Blocks password-based and OTP signups.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create triggers for updated_at on all tables\ncreate trigger users_updated_at_trigger\nbefore update on public.users\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_updated_at();\n\ncreate trigger teams_updated_at_trigger\nbefore update on public.teams\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_updated_at();\n\ncreate trigger profiles_updated_at_trigger\nbefore update on public.profiles\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_updated_at();\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to populate public.users\ndrop trigger if exists on_auth_user_created on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger on_auth_user_created\nafter insert on auth.users\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_new_auth_user();\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table for email domain validation\ndrop trigger if exists validate_czu_email_domain_trigger on auth.users;",
